I’m driven by the intersection of data and security—how insights can shield systems from unseen threats. Cybersecurity isn’t just a field for me; it’s a mission to protect the digital infrastructure that powers our world.  

As a Junior Data Scientist at CyberShield Analytics, I focus on transforming raw data into actionable intelligence. My work blends Python, SQL, and tools like Apache Spark to analyze patterns in network traffic, while Pandas and NumPy help clean and structure datasets for modeling. I’ve contributed to building data pipelines that feed into threat detection systems, and I’m passionate about making complex findings accessible through Matplotlib and Plotly dashboards.  

In my short time here, I’ve built a predictive model using scikit-learn that improved anomaly detection accuracy by 15%, and I’ve designed REST APIs to streamline data integration across teams. These projects let me combine my love for problem-solving with the high-stakes world of cyber defense.  

Seeking opportunities to collaborate on impactful projects, learn from seasoned experts, and grow alongside a team that values curiosity and innovation. Let’s build a future where technology is both powerful and protected.
